voiceSummary: Central Depository Services India Limited has scheduled an Analyst Investor Conference Call for Wednesday November 18 2026. The event is the Avendus Spark INDX Annual Investor Conference held in Mumbai. The meeting is a group session starting at 10.00 AM and ending at 01.00 PM. The company notes that the schedule is subject to change due to exigencies. No unpublished price sensitive information will be shared with analysts or institutional investors. Nilay Shah Company Secretary and Compliance Officer signed the notice.
